source_text: Et imposuerunt super caput eius causam eius scriptam: Hic est Jesus rex Iudaeorum. Occasione sive veritate Christus rex pronuntiatur, et omnis littera regnum eius testatur, sive Graecorum sive Romanorum sive Hebraeorum. Nulla alia causa mortis invenitur nisi: Rex fuit Iudaeorum — Ego autem constitutus sum rex ab eo super Sion.
pass_a_gloss: And they-placed upon head of-him the cause of-him written: This is Jesus king of-Jews. By-occasion or by-truth Christ king is-proclaimed, and every letter kingdom of-him witnesses, whether of-Greeks or of-Romans or of-Hebrews. No other cause of death is-found except: King he-was of-Jews — I however have-been-set king by him upon Zion.
pass_b_english: They [[put over his head the charge written: This is Jesus, the king of the Jews >> Bible:Matthew 27:37]]. By occasion or by truth Christ is proclaimed king, and every letter — Greek, Roman, Hebrew — witnesses his kingdom. No other cause of death is found except: he was King of the Jews — [[I have been set as king by him on Zion >> Bible:Psalm 2:6]].
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
